throughput_definitions.one_d_kernel: 4 complete transform outputs per accepted cycle
throughput_definitions.output_interface: 4 final coefficients per output_fire when req permits
throughput_definitions.single_fabric_2d: steady-state final-equivalent throughput must be calculated from V/H work and resource sharing; do not label it as 4/cycle
throughput_definitions.backpressure_latency: state-model result with stall-dependent completion; no fixed upper bound claimed

product_and_reference_instance_summary.direct_p4_product_requirement: 4*N products per cycle for an N-point direct matrix group; this is a mathematical product requirement, not a generic DSP lower bound
product_and_reference_instance_summary.N32: 128 direct products per cycle in the reference schedule
product_and_reference_instance_summary.N64: 256 direct products per cycle in direct form; factorized DCT2-64 uses the frozen 128-lane R4C reference schedule
product_and_reference_instance_summary.physical_multiplier_instance_count: Not selected in PRE; depends on the A/B/C architecture and any proven time sharing
